title: AI-assisted adaptive-optical robotic metrology for sub-millimeter localization and dimensional measurement of blind holes.
summary: A six-axis robot with AI image segmentation performs adaptive-optical blind-hole localization and dimensional measurement; comparison with CMM references across 30 physical samples reports sub-millimeter errors and repeatability, as a proof-of-concept metrology result. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
